title: Block value equals majority
statement: Let $x$ assign a sign in $\\{ -1,1 \\}$ to each of nine coordinates, and let $i$ be one of three block indices. The value of the depth-two block model at $i$ equals the majority sign of the three entries in the $i$th recursive input block: it is $+1$ when their sum is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A sign assignment on nine coordinates
A block index among three blocks
